note: From the Alaska Division of Elections' official sample ballots for House Districts 9, 17 and 24 in the Third Judicial District, which list the same superior and district court retention questions. All of the Municipality of Anchorage is in the Third Judicial District. Each judge on a retention ballot is the sitting judge. Anchorage Assembly, mayor, school board and municipal bond propositions are decided in the April municipal election; the sample ballots show no Anchorage municipal item on this ballot, so there is no city section. Not shown: State House and Senate districts. Supreme Court Justice Jude Pate's retention and Ballot Measures 2 and 3 are statewide and not repeated here. Check your official sample ballot.
